title: Add RAG session replayer CLI and probe harness for deterministic debugging
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a local CLI to replay RAG sessions and a probe harness for deterministic telemetry collection; developer tooling only, no breaking API changes.
description:
Context / motivation: Debugging RAG sessions end-to-end is currently laborious — reproducing flaky tool-calls, prompt ordering, or KV-cache interactions requires manual orchestration. This PR introduces a lightweight session replayer CLI and a developer 'probe harness' that records and replays deterministic session traces to make root-cause analysis reproducible across machines.

What this does (high level): Adds a small CLI (rwd-replay) that can ingest recorded session traces (jsonl) captured by Redwood SDK instrumenters, replay model+tool interactions against a local dev shim or remote test endpoint, and assert deterministic outputs. Includes a probe harness library for capturing traces (events, token deltas, tool invocations, KV-cache snapshots) with a minimal on-disk format and a companion set of quickstart docs and examples.

Motivation / scope: Target audience is engineers and SDK consumers debugging tool-calling agents and RAG workflows. Not intended as a production tracer or provenance log; traces are opt-in dev artifacts. The goal is to speed triage of issues reported in evals/qa or by customers by making it simpler to reproduce a failing session locally.

Checklist implemented: 
- [x] CLI: rwd-replay with subcommands: capture, replay, validate, summarize.
- [x] Probe harness: lightweight Python/TS instrumentation hooks that emit jsonl traces.
- [x] Quickstart: docs/quickstart explaining capture->replay loop and common debugging patterns.
- [x] Tests: unit tests for replay determinism and integration smoke against the shim runner.
- [x] Samples: two recorded sample traces (simple-qa.jsonl, multi-tool.jsonl) and a demo notebook.
- [x] Lint and formatting for Python/TS.

Small illustrative snippet (replayer CLI usage):
$ rwd-replay capture --endpoint=http://localhost:8080 --out=samples/session.jsonl
$ rwd-replay replay --trace=samples/session.jsonl --shim=local-shim --assert=golden/expected.json

Edge cases and limitations:
- Replay is deterministic only when the trace includes tool responses; for live model calls with non-deterministic sampling, we recommend using the shim or setting fixed sampling seeds.
- Traces are intentionally compact; capturing full document contents is opt-in and discouraged for PII-sensitive flows.

Migration / roll-forward notes:
- No API changes to Redwood runtime. This is developer tooling stored in examples and docs; can be adopted incrementally by teams.

Merge outcome: Squash merge to main. Commit message: "Add RAG session replayer CLI and probe harness; quickstart and samples for deterministic debugging"

Follow-ups (future work):
- Add Rust shim for local high-performance replay.
- Integrate trace visualization plugin into the dev console.
- Provide a secure optional storage helper for teams that want to persist traces behind KMS.

If you want to try it locally: see docs/quickstarts/replay-debugging.md and run the demo notebook. Feedback welcome — aiming to iterate quickly based on team's debugging needs.
